CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT 1999

CONSUMER PROTECTION (FUTURE SERVICES CONTRACT) (AMENDMENT)
ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 17(1) of the Consumer Protection
Act 1999 [Act 599], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the  Consumer Protection (Future Services
Contract) (Amendment) Order 2014.

(2)  This Order comes into operation on 11 July 2014.

Amendment of Schedule
2. The Consumer Protection (Future Services Contract) Order 2002
[P.U. (A) 400/2002] is amended by substituting for the Schedule the following Schedule:
